scripts.check: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):[p.join(d,e.name)]);const files=[...walk('server'),...walk('scripts'),...walk('public/js')].filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).sort();for(const f of files)execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('syntax ok: '+files.length+' files')"
scripts.check:all: npm run -s check && npm run -s check:json && npm run -s check:data && npm run -s check:dom && npm run -s check:contrast && npm run -s check:xss && npm run -s check:refs && npm run -s check:offline && npm run -s check:sim && npm test --silent && npm run -s bench:sim && npm run -s check:mem && npm run -s smoke
scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let bad=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('data').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json'))){try{JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/'+f,'utf8'));console.log('ok   data/'+f)}catch(e){bad++;console.error('FAIL data/'+f+': '+e.message)}}process.exit(bad?1:0)"
scripts.check:frontend: npm run -s check && npm run -s check:dom && npm run -s check:refs && npm run -s check:xss && npm run -s check:offline && npm run -s check:contrast
scripts.check:offline: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):[p.join(d,e.name)]);const bad=walk('public').filter(f=>/(index|mobile)\.html$|\/(css|js)\//.test(f)).filter(f=>/(src|href)=[\x22\x27]https?:|@import\s+url\([\x22\x27]?https?:|fonts\.googleapis|cdn\./.test(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')));if(bad.length){console.error('External dependencies in:',bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('No external CDN dependencies in public/')"
scripts.check:sim: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const lines=fs.readdirSync('server/sim').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).flatMap(f=>fs.readFileSync('server/sim/'+f,'utf8').split('\n').map((l,i)=>[f,i+1,l.replace(/\/\/.*$/,'')])).filter(([,,l])=>!/^\s*\*/.test(l));const bad=[[/Math\.random\s*\(/,'Math.random()'],[/require\(['\x22](fs|http|https|net|child_process|dgram|dns|tls)['\x22]\)|\bfetch\s*\(|XMLHttpRequest|readFileSync|writeFileSync/,'I/O or network']];let n=0;for(const [f,i,l] of lines)for(const [re,what] of bad)if(re.test(l)){n++;console.error(f+':'+i+': '+what)}if(n)process.exit(1);console.log('server/sim: no Math.random(), no I/O, no network')"
scripts.test:stream4: npm run -s check:sim && node --test server/sim/test/*.test.js server/test/loom.test.js server/test/contracts.test.js && npm run -s bench:sim && npm run -s calibrate
